content:
We are organizing a Lean Hackathon at the University of Washington in Seattle during the weekend of May 8 - 10, 2026. See the website for details.

To kick-off the Hackathon, Leonardo de Moura will be giving a colloquium for the Math and CS departments on Friday May 8 at 3:30 pm. See the colloquium announcement for the title and abstract. The colloquium will be followed by a reception for hackathon participants and researchers.
